_studyNote_root: This is the agent's BRAIN CONFIG. Schema v1.8 ships with SPFx 1.24 beta.3. Every key starting with _studyNote is an annotation for learning ONLY — DELETE them in a real scaffold or manifest validation fails.
name: Hello Agent
description: Greets you by name and can open a small full-screen dashboard inside Copilot.
_studyNote_instructions: Pulled from instruction.txt so behavior lives in text, not code. Change the agent's persona/guardrails there.
_studyNote_starters: Buttons shown to the user when the agent opens. Make them map to real tool calls.
_studyNote_capabilities: Optional built-in Copilot capabilities the agent may use (e.g. web search, code interpreter, graphic art). Omit or trim to least-privilege.
_studyNote_actions: Each action references a plugin file (ai-plugin.json) that exposes your component's TOOLS to the model. No action here = your tools are invisible to the agent.
